Piano Keyboard

A playable two-octave piano in your browser — click keys or use your computer keyboard.

Computer keys: A W S E D F T G Y H U J K = C4 … C5, O L P ; ' continue up. Click keys or use your keyboard.

Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Click the piano keys with your mouse.
  2. Or play with your computer keyboard (A–K row).
  3. Adjust the volume slider to taste.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are the piano sounds made?

Oscillators with a piano-like envelope, synthesized live with the Web Audio API.

Which computer keys play notes?

The bottom letter row: A plays C, W plays C#, S plays D, and so on across two octaves.

What range does it cover?

C4 to B5 — two full octaves.
